title: Ay Paalne Waale
body:
sheh ran may ye farmate thay
ay paalne waale ay paalne waale
ek baap kaleje se sina kaise nikaale
<<DIVIDER>>
hum naad e ali padte hai aajayega aaram
yun aediyan ragdo na mere gaysuon waale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kehke giri qaime may maa dasht may shabbir
akbar gaye ruqsat huwe aankhon ke ujaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
yan garm lahoo behta tha akbar ke jigar se
padte thay kaleje pe wahan laila ke chaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad de jawab apni behen ka ali akbar
qasid ko koi laasha e akbar pe bulaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
laila se kaha sheh ne rida daal ke apni
is zakhm ko zainab ki nigahon se chipaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab laashon pe zainab ne har ek maa ko sambhala
ab laasha e akbar hai usay kaun sambhale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ye kehte huwe sheh ne rakha laasha
koi mere abbas ko darya se bulaale
ay paalne waale...
